results.question: Is 'Read more' acceptable link text?
results.answer_preview:
No. "Read more" on its own isn't acceptable link text. The headless component conventions say link text must describe the destination, so "Click here" and "Read more" on their own are not allowed [6].

results.question: How do we add click tracking?
results.answer_preview:
Click tracking is attached with `data-track` attributes that the analytics script reads. For example, you would use `data-track="promo-cta"` [1].

Don't use inline `onclick` handlers for this [1].
